note: ERP values are decimals (e.g. 0.0486 = 4.86%). CDS spreads are also decimals. Countries without Moody's ratings use PRS composite scores.

fields.equity_risk_premium: Total equity risk premium = mature market ERP + country risk premium (decimal)
fields.country_risk_premium: Additional country-specific risk premium above mature market (decimal)
fields.cds_spread: 10-year CDS spread as of 12/31/2025 (decimal, null if unavailable)
fields.frontier_market: True if country lacks sovereign rating and uses PRS score method
fields.prs_composite_score: PRS political risk score (frontier markets only, higher = less risk)
